subject: Ankheg
picture: An original burrowing insect monster bursts out of a dungeon floor: long segmented insect body, hard shell plates, six legs, two large mandibles, simple antennae. Do not imitate or trace any published creature illustration. Burst earth as large clods. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. The hole it came from shows stone and dirt outlines, not a black void.
